mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.05 in any 12-month rolling window or the average 20-day return in declining FEDFUNDS periods is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day SPX return in months with UNRATE > 4.5% is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 40% of instances or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5% YoY), the Federal Reserve pursues aggressive tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day SPX return in CPIAUCSL > 5% YoY periods is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 in high inflation regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day SPX return in INDPRO decline months is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When annual GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.5%, it signals strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day SPX return in GDPC1 > 2.5% growth quarters is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous slowing of employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 40% of instances or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes (characterized by rising housing starts), consumer confidence and spending increase, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day SPX return in HOUST-rising early-cycle periods is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.04.
